status: Fourteen unwired v1 wall/floor WebP candidates cover every route room except kernel_guard; the Dog-leg Passage's two exact-periodic v2 WebPs were promoted into src/assets/rooms/kernel-duelist/textures/ on 2026-08-11 when its live room mesh arrived, and their -candidate copies remain here as the recorded source of that promotion. modelVersion: unknown (the built-in image generation surface did not report a model id)
runtimeEncoding: v1: 1024x1024 lossy WebP, cwebp 1.6.0, quality 86, method 6, sharp YUV, metadata stripped. Dog-leg v2: that same lossy stage is decoded, opposite 1px borders are averaged onto both sides, then the exact-periodic pixels are stored as lossless WebP with metadata stripped.
